'''Marcus Cosgrove''' (also published as '''Marc Cosgrove''') was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Rogue 23 from Winnipeg, Man. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (geocities.ws/plarathas). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref> Marcus Cosgrove also posted on Decipher's [[swccg-discussion]] list in 1998.<ref name="list-66055">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/66055.html? swccg-discussion message #66055], Marc Cosgrove (1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000110053228/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/66055.html? Internet Archive]</ref>
